notes: Void Island and meeting reminders are on by default, with English support for Island. Improved Island settings and month view; fixed the macOS app icon on versions before macOS 26. Upgrade note: Island and meeting reminders are switched on once after this update, even if previously disabled. Turn them off again in Settings if preferred; your choice is kept from then on. If Dock or Launchpad still shows a square icon, run killall Dock to refresh the cached icon.
